data.name: Silent Speech
desc: You can speak telepathically to one creature you can see within 30 feet; it understands you only if you share a language.

data.name: Superior Darkvision
desc: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

data.name: Stone Camouflage
desc: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.
